_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: transactions_fts
data.create_virtual_stmt: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "transactions_fts" USING fts5(note_ascii, transaction_id UNINDEXED)

sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions_fts" USING fts5(note_ascii, transaction_id UNINDEXED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wallets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_color_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "source_id" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "jars" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "wallet_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_color_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "carry_over" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("carry_over" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'spend', "goal_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES savings_goals (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_color_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "emoji" TEXT NULL, "parent_category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "wallet_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id), "jar_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES jars (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "counterparty_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "principal_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "note" TEXT NULL, "wallet_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id), "is_transfer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_transfer" IN (0, 1)), "linked_transaction_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "goal_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES savings_goals (id), "debt_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES debts (id), "note_ascii" TEXT NULL, "receipt_image_filename" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_keywords" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "keyword" TEXT NOT NULL, "keyword_ascii" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("category_id", "keyword"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "year_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carry_over" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("carry_over" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("category_id", "year_month"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_occurrence_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "transaction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_templates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_color_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "context_json" TEXT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_transactions_source_id ON transactions (source_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_savings_goals_source_id ON savings_goals (source_id)
